excerpt: Assess the advantages and trade-offs of buying a Maryam Island apartment, including the specific building, waterfront access, ownership and costs.
introduction:
Maryam Island can appeal to a buyer who wants a Sharjah waterfront apartment and access to a promenade, but the merits depend on the exact building, unit and price. Check the actual view and facilities, ownership right, service charges and daily journeys before deciding.

This guide separates the project's stated features from property-specific questions. The numerical example shows how purchase costs and annual income fit into a single calculation.
takeaways: Verify the building, phase, actual view and facilities instead of assuming all Maryam Island apartments are identical.
Confirm the buyer's ownership right and obtain current title, payment and service-charge information.
Compare the total cost and intended use with realistic alternatives, including future maintenance and resale.

sections.heading: What is Maryam Island?
sections.body:
[Shurooq's Maryam Island overview](https://shurooq.gov.ae/portfolio/maryam-island) describes a mixed-use development between Al Khan Lagoon and Al Mamzar, developed with Eagle Hills Sharjah. The [project website](https://maryamisland.ae/) describes apartments, retail and waterfront facilities. These are project-level descriptions; the status and access of a specific building must be checked.

A potential advantage is the choice of a waterfront setting and community amenities. The practical trade-off is that view, access, completion stage and costs can vary by unit. Walk the route from the actual building to the facilities you expect to use and ask whether they are open and included.

The [Sharjah family area guide](/journal/best-areas-to-buy-property-in-sharjah-for-families) offers a wider comparison if your household is considering other settings.

sections.heading: Inspect the building and the view
sections.body:
Visit the exact apartment and record the floor, orientation, view, layout, storage, parking and noise. Inspect the unit and its outlook to understand the view from the apartment. Check the current surroundings and ask about nearby construction or planned buildings that could affect the outlook.

Inspect windows, balcony, cooling, plumbing and visible moisture. Ask about building maintenance and arrange a qualified inspection where appropriate. A coastal setting makes it sensible to check exposed fittings and the maintenance plan, but it does not establish a defect in a particular building.

For off-plan, review the signed plan, specification, progress and handover provisions. Confirm which facilities are contractual and when they are expected to be ready.

sections.heading: What will the purchase and ownership cost?
sections.body:
Add the agreed price, buyer-paid registration and brokerage, applicable finance costs, inspection and initial work. Ask for a written property-specific quote and keep a separate contingency. Request the unit's current service-charge statement, what it covers and any outstanding balance.

For illustration, assume a sample apartment price of AED 1,000,000, AED 45,000 acquisition costs and AED 15,000 initial setup. The total before a separate reserve is AED 1,060,000. The example combines the purchase price, acquisition costs and initial work in one budget.

The chart separates the example components. Annual service charges, financing repayments, utilities and eventual selling costs need to be budgeted separately.

sections.heading: Confirm the ownership right
sections.body:
Ask Sharjah's registration department to confirm the right available to your nationality for the exact unit. Review the title or initial registration, seller authority, any mortgage or tenancy and required developer clearance. The [Sharjah ownership eligibility guide](/journal/how-to-check-foreign-ownership-eligibility-in-sharjah) explains why a project description does not replace this check.

If buying from a developer, confirm the registered project, payment recipient, instalments and expected registration outcome. If buying a resale, reconcile the seller's documents, any remaining payments and the transfer terms. Verify payment instructions independently.

Ask a qualified adviser about unclear contract terms and retain the signed agreement, receipts and issued registration documents.

sections.heading: Consider the daily routine or investment
sections.body:
For a home, test school, work and healthcare journeys from the actual building at the required times. Ask schools about admission and transport, and check access to shops and parking. A waterfront lifestyle is useful only if it works with the rest of the household routine.

For a rental investment, seek recent signed leases for similar apartments and deduct vacancy, service charges, management, repairs and insurance. Do not treat a project's marketing description or an area-wide yield as a guarantee of collected rent.

Review nearby competing supply and completed sales where evidence is available. A future resale price and the time needed to find a buyer remain uncertain.

sections.heading: Weigh the trade-offs
sections.body:
List what matters most: view, usable layout, transport, facilities, total cost and the ability to hold the property. A building with a desirable position may have a different price or charge from another project. Compare those differences using current documents, not a general assumption that waterfront always commands a particular premium.

Test an unexpected repair, a delayed handover or a longer vacancy. Keep sufficient cash after the purchase and ask whether your plans would still work under a less favourable scenario.

Ask how the community is managed, whether a particular pool or beach access is included and how residents report a fault. Check service-charge statements and building rules before attributing a benefit to every apartment. If the apartment is tenanted, review the lease and the deposit and confirm when possession can be given. These details can materially affect the timing and cost of the purchase.

sections.heading: Request current Maryam Island options
sections.body:
Browse [Aliyas Maryam Island projects](/projects?emirate=Sharjah&area=sharjah-maryam-island) and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget and intended use. Ask which specific units are currently available and request the plan, price, current charges and documents. Compare the exact floor and layout with other homes you have inspected and record the source and date of each quotation.

Confirm eligibility and official requirements before committing.
